state:
Goal `core-xml-writer`: `Core\Xml\Writer::attribute` has all its feature proofs. `Core\Xml\Writer` has its class card (`WRITER_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`), so it is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. Every other Writer member still owes examples, hostile, perf and a Rust test.
The attack found a real bug, now fixed: `attribute`'s duplicate-name check scanned every earlier name, so 100,000 attributes on one element ran past 25s. The tag's names are now array keys (one lookup).
Gap `nvs-stdlib/an-xml-writer-holds-a-string-per-piece` still stands: every emitted piece is its own string, so a bench or attack that writes millions of pieces stops at the memory limit. Keep new writer attacks under about 500,000 pieces, or mark them with that gap.
Member cards are rewritten in plain words when their member's slice lands (`ATTRIBUTE_DOC` is the model). `COMMENT_DOC` and `CDATA_DOC` are still in the old dense voice.
